anchors.rule: Each role runs on its explicit model.
anchors.enforcedBy: The Lead and helper command gate (P6), with each role's model resolved per call (P3).

anchors.rule: Feature, bug-fix and refactor code is delegated.
anchors.enforcedBy: A helper is the Lead's only route to code-writing (P5, P6).

anchors.rule: Code-writing goes to the role's helper, on its configured model.
anchors.anchor: Delegate code-writing to a subagent using your configured feature model
anchors.enforcedBy: The role-to-model map in `machine/flow/role-models.mjs`, with the Lead choosing the role (P3).

anchors.rule: Each role has a default model.
anchors.enforcedBy: The picker's `~/.config/julia/lead-role-models.md` plus the defaults in `dashboard/config/roles.json` (P3).
Helpers are created with no `agents`, so they cannot delegate (P5).
One thread per delegation, from stock Mastra (P5).

anchors.rule: A stopped run resumes from its saved point.
anchors.enforcedBy: The adopt-or-start build step over stock Mastra recovery (P7).
